nodes.label: hosted-anthropic Experiment Profile
nodes.rationale: The deliberate opposite of the default: every component hosted, and the only configuration in which citations are verified against the source text rather than asserted by the model. Exists as a quality ceiling to measure the local stack against — specifically to quantify qwen3:8b's numeric-fidelity gap. claude-opus-5 with effort low and cache_system_prompt, claude-haiku-4-5 as fast_llm, OpenAI text-embedding-3-large, chunk 1200/150, 40 candidates → top 8, max_tokens 4096.

nodes.label: 3072-Dimension Embedding Caveat
nodes.rationale: text-embedding-3-large is 3072-dimensional, exceeding pgvector's 2000-dimension HNSW limit, so the migration leaves the column unindexed and vector search falls back to an exact scan. It also needs its own database (osc_hosted3072) because vector width is fixed when the chunks table is created. This is the exact configuration that would have aborted migration before the conditional-index fix.

nodes.label: Hosted Models Lift the Prompt Budget
nodes.rationale: Hosted models are served with a large context, so the prompt budget the local 4096-token deployment is constrained to no longer applies — chunk_size rises 900→1200, overlap 120→150, candidates 30→40, top_k 5→8 and max_tokens 1500→4096. A concrete demonstration that the local tuning is a deployment constraint, not a retrieval finding.
